description: Use when you need a US public company's SEC EDGAR filings and key financials by ticker or CIK: latest filings (form, dates, accession, link; filter by form, since) plus latest XBRL facts: revenue. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /sec/filings, $0.003 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For several companies at once use sec_filings_batch. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (send this or ticker)

form.description: optional comma list of form types to keep, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K

ticker.description: stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B (send this or cik)

name: sec_filings
title: SEC filings
